summary_en: SBINM LLC (subsidiary of SBI Holdings) extended the tender offer period for BASE shares from October 15 to October 21, 2026 (34 business days total) following notification that major shareholder Hiroyuki Maki intends to resume purchases targeting over 30% ownership. Purchase price remains 340 yen per share with maximum 23,792,300 shares. BASE's board reaffirms support for the offer and neutrality on shareholder participation.
title_en: Notice of Amendment regarding Board Support and Neutral Opinion on Tender Offer for Shares by SBINM LLC and Execution of Capital and Business Alliance Agreement with SBI Holdings
translation_en_brief:
BASE, Inc. announced an amendment to its disclosure regarding the tender offer by SBINM LLC (a wholly owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings) for the company's common shares. The bidder extended the tender offer period from the originally scheduled October 15, 2026 to October 21, 2026, resulting in a total of 34 business days. This extension followed notification that Hiroyuki Maki, a major shareholder holding over 30%, intends to resume purchases of BASE shares with a target to increase his ownership stake above 30%.

The tender offer price remains fixed at 340 yen per share, with the maximum number of shares to be purchased unchanged at 23,792,300 shares. The stated objective of achieving associate company accounting treatment (under the equity method) also remains unchanged. The extension was decided to provide shareholders with additional opportunity to make informed decisions regarding tender offer participation, taking into account the subscription status and future outlook following the commencement of the tender offer on August 31, 2026.

BASE's board of directors maintains its position of support for the tender offer and neutrality regarding shareholder participation, confirming that no changes to the board's opinion have been made. The company emphasizes that decisions regarding tender offer participation remain at the discretion of shareholders.
